bullet_bank.text: Automated capacity-report preparation with AI and multiple data sources, improving standardization and report quality.
Used AI-assisted processes to integrate JIRA, Microsoft SQL Server and Splunk as automated capacity-data sources.
Used Copilot, AI and Python to organize, catalog and support migration of Power BI reports.
Researched an LLM-enabled team knowledge base and analyst command-center concept using Python and PowerShell; research/investigation, not production.
Built Python/Pandas ETL for P95 telemetry from 6,000+ endpoints, adding validation, cleansing, anomaly checks and Oracle history.
Developed Python and scikit-learn forecasting models to identify capacity risks 3-6 months ahead and support provisioning and rightsizing.
Managed enterprise capacity requests, monthly reporting and seasonal analysis with BMC TrueSight, CA APM and AppDynamics.
Managed Dynatrace AppMon/Synthetics, analyzed performance bottlenecks and supported an AWS migration.
Delivered CA APM consulting for estates of roughly 4,000-6,000 agents and 50+ Enterprise Managers, including sizing, monitoring design and client training.
Migrated a shopping engine from 200+ MySQL nodes to six-node Oracle RAC, optimizing C++/OCCI processing with approximately 95% less hardware and sub-second latency.
Built a Python/PySpark forecasting project with Prophet, scikit-learn and Streamlit; the master records about 90% shorter forecasting cycles and bottleneck prediction up to six months ahead.
Built a Python agentic job-search pipeline using FAISS retrieval, LLM scoring and tailoring, document generation, quality gates, MCP and application tracking.
Designed an AWS S3/Glue/Athena/Bedrock lakehouse project with a Text-to-SQL agent and Parquet/Snappy storage optimization.
